terminalNames: shipped page authenticates, sends server request ID, renders frames as text and allows another turn
confirmation displays the real route and only starts after Allow once
denied consent never starts a turn and preserves the message
Stop waits for the cancelled terminal and does not claim completion
reload reuses the authenticated session and replays without another start
an unpaired page remains unavailable without sending provider work
reconnect invalidates an in-flight preflight before it can decide or start
scope: Actual shipped HTML in Chromium against controlled HTTP API fixture; not packaged daemon/live provider acceptance
